statements.hypotheses: Smooth connected compact Kähler X; effective rational SNC B with coefficients <1; J=K_X+B pseudo-effective; M in Pic(X) tensor Q nef; D=J+M nef.
statements.conclusion: There is a semiample rational line L on X with c1(L)=c1(D) in real Bott–Chern cohomology.
statements.checking: Statement matched with the fixed source and bilingual article; author claim, not certification.

statements.hypotheses: Same smooth compact Kähler/klt data with J pseudo-effective and M nef; J+M need not be nef.
statements.conclusion: A smooth compact Kähler modification mu:U->T, semiample rational line P, effective rational divisor R with mu*(J+M) numerically equivalent to P+R and R=N(c1(mu*(J+M))); additionally a(T)=0 implies c1(M)=0.
statements.checking: Statement matched with the fixed source and bilingual article; author claim, not certification.

statements.hypotheses: Dimension n>=1 and the algebraic-dimension-zero assertion in all smaller dimensions; a(T)=0; effective rational SNC klt B; K_T+B pseudo-effective.
statements.conclusion: Every nef rational holomorphic line M has c1(M)=0.
statements.checking: Statement matched with the fixed source and bilingual article; author claim, not certification.

statements.hypotheses: Full Theorem 1.2 in lower dimensions; smooth connected compact Kähler n-fold with 0<a(T)<n; holomorphic algebraic reduction h:T->W with smooth projective base and connected fibers; effective rational SNC klt B; J pseudo-effective; M nef.
statements.conclusion: c1(M restricted to F)=0 for a general smooth fiber F.
statements.checking: Statement matched with the fixed source and bilingual article; author claim, not certification.

statements.hypotheses: Effective rational klt pair (Y,D) on normal compact Kähler Y; connected-fiber surjection f:Y->Z to normal projective Z; dimY>dimZ; rational Cartier H with K_Y+D Q-linearly equivalent to f*H.
statements.conclusion: H Q-linearly equivalent to K_Z+D_Z with effective rational D_Z and (Z,D_Z) klt.
statements.checking: Statement matched with the fixed source and bilingual article; author claim, not certification.
